faqs.q: Sec. 102-209. - Bimonthly billing and annual review.
faqs.a:
On or before July 1 of each year, the director of finance shall review the water usage
               of each sewer system user for the preceding months as specified in
section 102-207
and make the required sewer service charge computation. Beginning each July 1 with
               the next billing cycle, each sewer system user will be billed each two months in the
               amount so computed.
(Code 1981, § 33-113; Ord. No. 2574, § 1, 11-21-1988)
